data.name: support.description
data.value: Frequently asked questions about the somine app, and how to reach us for support.

data.name: support.reportSubtitle
data.value: If you come across objectionable or upsetting content, tell us.

data.name: support.faq1A
data.value: somine lets you gather everything you like on Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest and other platforms into one place. Just tap the share button in any app and choose somine. You can save links, notes or images; links point back to the original platform, so nothing is copied.

data.name: support.faq2Q
data.value: How do I create a collection?

data.name: support.faq2A
data.value: Open the Collections tab and tap the + button in the top right. You can give each collection its own name and icon.

data.name: support.faq3Q
data.value: What do I get on the free plan?

data.name: support.faq3A
data.value: The free plan gives you 10 collections, 500 items in total, 3 active reminders and 5 collection shares a month. Public share links, cloud sync, search, the home-screen widget, the weekly digest notification, automatic dark mode and data export are free too.

data.name: support.faq4A
data.value: Premium removes the limits on collections, items, reminders and shares. It also unlocks the Hidden Vault (Face ID), the Midnight and Vibe themes, and 5 custom app icons. Premium is an auto-renewing App Store subscription, billed weekly, monthly or yearly; you see the current price in the app before you buy.

data.name: support.faq5Q
data.value: How does the Hidden Vault work?

data.name: support.faq5A
data.value: The Hidden Vault is a Premium feature. It locks the collections you choose behind Face ID: until you unlock it, their items aren't downloaded to your device and never appear in the home-screen widget or in notifications. Collections in the Vault can't have a public link.

data.name: support.faq6Q
data.value: How do I share a collection with a friend?

data.name: support.faq6A
data.value: There are two ways. Share with a person: enter your friend's username, and once they accept, the collection appears in their library and they see your display name and username. On the free plan you can send 5 share requests a month (declined ones count too); Premium has no limit. Public link: anyone with the link can see the collection and your display name. You can revoke the link at any time, and the page stops working the moment you do.

data.name: support.faq7A
data.value: Give any saved item a date and time. When it comes due, your phone shows a notification and the reminder also appears in the in-app Notifications list. You can set repeating reminders too. On top of that, the weekly digest nudges you on Sunday evening about items you never opened — you can turn it off in Settings.

data.name: support.faq8Q
data.value: What should I do if I see objectionable content in a shared collection?

data.name: support.faq8A
data.value: Open the collection, tap the "…" button in the top right and choose "Report collection". The same menu lets you block the person or remove the collection from your library. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours, and the person you report never sees who reported them. To report a public link, write to abuse@somineapp.com; the "Reporting content" section on this page has the details.

data.name: support.faq9Q
data.value: How do I delete my account?

data.name: support.faq9A
data.value: In the app, go to Profile > Account Info > Delete Account to erase your account and all your data permanently and immediately. Before you do, you can use Profile > "Export your data" to download your saves as JSON or CSV. Deleting your account doesn't cancel your App Store subscription; cancel that separately.

data.name: support.faq10Q
data.value: How do I manage or cancel my subscription?

data.name: support.faq10A
data.value: Subscriptions are managed by Apple: on your iPhone go to Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions > somine. When you cancel, Premium stays on until the end of the period you paid for. To avoid renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Only Apple can issue refunds.
